hints.title: Wildcard Partition
hints.text: Split the pattern string at the unique asterisk into a prefix string and suffix string.

hints.title: Prefix Search
hints.text: Locate the earliest occurrence of the prefix in string s.

hints.title: Non-Overlapping Suffix Search
hints.text: Verify whether suffix appears at or after the index following the prefix match.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def hasMatch(self, s: str, p: str) -> bool:
        star_idx = p.find('*')
        prefix = p[:star_idx]
        suffix = p[star_idx + 1:]
        
        i = s.find(prefix)
        if i == -1:
            return False
            
        j = s.find(suffix, i + len(prefix))
        return j != -1
```

complexity.notes: Linear searches for prefix and subsequent suffix across string s.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Overlapping matches or backwards matching violates wildcard semantics.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(m) space stores split prefix and suffix pattern substrings.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Splits by asterisk and performs two sequential index lookups.
